name: 二十二岁的疯玛吉
description: 二十二岁；身高约170厘米；女性中音，清锐强硬，英式英语口音。

attributes.movement: 动作敏捷有力，能够熟练攀爬船体索具并使用刀剑近身战斗。

variants.appearance: 二十二岁，金色长发，手臂带纹身，穿带紧身胸衣的年轻空盗服装，腿侧佩有刀鞘。
variants.stage1_prompt:
Twenty-two-year-old woman, 170 cm tall, slim, compact, and athletic, with angular features, a notched eyebrow, and intimidating expression. Her blond shoulder-length wolf cut has dark roots, choppy crown layers, broken fringe, and tousled face-framing pieces. Blue-black wind, blade, and cloud tattoos cover both arms.

She wears an asymmetric ink-blue fitted coat-dress ending high on one thigh and lower on the opposite side, built from overlapping wool and brocade panels. One shoulder has a narrow structured cap while the other remains sleeveless. Smoke-gray semi-transparent fishnet panels cross one collarbone, one side of the ribs, and the upper back, each framed by black binding. Crimson lining, cream stitching, blackened-brass clasps, uneven pleated frills, and a short trailing sash create layered fantasy detail.

Dark charcoal nylon leggings are slightly sheer, with restrained ladders and small irregular tears at one knee and outer thigh. Narrow brown leather straps cross the waist, one shoulder, and one thigh at different angles, carrying the sword, two small utility cases, and brass personal charms without military webbing. A compact dagger sits in a fitted dark-leather holster strapped securely to her outer thigh. She wears mismatched black fingerless gloves: one wrist-length, one extending halfway up the forearm.

Her worn vintage boots are dark brown leather, ankle-high, with rounded toes, close Victorian lacing, low stacked heels, creased shafts, rubbed edges, repaired stitching, and tarnished buckles.

Full-body stance on a skyship deck. Complete flat-color 2D production concept, six-head proportions, crisp varied-width ink, opaque flat colors with controlled sheer panels, minimal texture, no lighting, shading, gradients, or painterly rendering.
